description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Propose an Airdrop Farmer plan for your owner: pass amount_usdc (the best split over the farms the agent runs) or allocations {farm id: USD}. Returns ONE approve_url; the owner opens it signed in, ticks any eligibility statement a farm needs and approves. Nothing is saved or moved before that, and an agent never starts a farm. From EventTrader's Airdrop Farmer (cymetica.com/airdrop-farmer): one amount split across airdrop farms of protocols with no token yet; a farm is listed only after its token has no market and its own points or testnet page was read with the programme running. One farm wallet per person, never pooled; the owner's own coins pay every fee. No airdrop is promised.
name: airdrop_farm_propose_plan
title: Airdrop Farm Propose Plan
